Folder: /BP/TS-117 Global - Task configuration
Labels: teamtree

Description:
Zmiana Start/End Date na tasku:
 * resize na Gantt 
 * zmiana w Jira Issue

1. Navigate to Gantt module of boxName

   Expected: Gantt module is displayed. Column View is set to "TC3211". FolLowing tasks are visible on WBS and Gantt chart:
- TC-3211 Global - Task configuration - Editing start/end date on Gantt and Jira side - Start/End Date fields mapped to Start/End Date (project task)
- Task_1
- Task_2
- Task_3
2. Grab the end of taskName and move it 2 days to the future. Refresh the page
   Data: taskName: Task_1
   Expected: Task_1 is resized on Chart to 3 days. 
Start date is 13/Apr/22, End date is 15/Apr/22.
The value of End Date (Jira and Built-in) fields in WBS are correctly updated to 15/Apr/22.
3. Grab the start of taskName and move it 2 days back. Refresh the page
   Data: taskName: Task_1
   Expected: Task_1 is resized on Chart to 5 days. 
Start date is 11/Apr/22, End date is 15/Apr/22.
The value of Start Date (Jira and Built-in) fields in WBS are correctly updated to 11/Apr/22.
4. Click on task key of taskName to open jira issue view
   Data: taskName: Task_2
   Expected: Jira issue view of Task_2 is opened in the new tab
5. Change Start date value
   Data: date value:11/Apr/22
   Expected: Start date is changed to 11/Apr/22
6. Go back to Gantt module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-3211 Global - Task configuration - Editing start/end date on Gantt and Jira side - Start/End Date fields mapped to Start/End Date
   Expected: Gantt module is displayed. Task_2 is resized on Chart to 3 days. 
Start date is 11/Apr/22, End date is 13/Apr/22. 
The value of Start Date (Jira and Built-in) fields in WBS are correctly updated to 11/Apr/22.
7. Click on task key of taskName to open jira issue view
   Data: taskName: Task_3
   Expected: Jira issue view of Task_3 is opened in the new tab
8. Change End date value
   Data: date value:15/Apr/22
   Expected: End date is changed to 15/Apr/22
9. Go back to Gantt module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-3211 Global - Task configuration - Editing start/end date on Gantt and Jira side - Start/End Date fields mapped to Start/End Date
   Expected: Gantt module is displayed. Task_3 is resized on Chart to 3 days. 
Start date is 13/Apr/22, End date is 15/Apr/22.
